## Standard Error of averaged player estimates

This is essentially says how much does a players' performance vary, how consistent of a performer are they?
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)
readRDS("se_plot.rds")
```

## Optimisation Curve Illustrating flatness around minimum

The reason for not choosing the absolute minimum but taking a point nearby is explained in
more depth in section 3.3 of the full report. The plot here shows that the curve is flat around the minimum which means if we change our choice of hyperparameters the log loss we are trying to minimise does not change in a significant way.
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(plotly)
readRDS("bt_surface.rds")
```
